Hi Vanessa — thanks for reaching out and congrats on getting this far. Short answers and next steps: 

1) Publisher account setup
- We'll send an invite to your publisher admin (publisher@redwood.com). The portal will ask for legal entity information, signing authority, and a W-9/Tax form for US publishers.
- For co-sell enablement we'll need your MPN ID and the contact for your partner sales manager.

2) Technical validation
- For SaaS offers we run a functional validation against the endpoints you provide. Typical turnaround is 48–72 hours after you upload the offer and required artifacts (manifest, test plan, credentials).
- Required items for validation: offer-manifest.yaml, sample/test API key (scoped to a test tenant), a health-check endpoint that returns 200 in <5s, and a short smoke-test script or Postman collection.

3) Packaging notes
- Use the Marketplace Publisher Center guided flow for SaaS offers. For the manifest, make sure to include the commercial terms and pricing links even if you're not publishing price (you can set 'Contact for pricing').

I'll attach our validation guidelines to this thread. Once you upload the offer to Partner Center, reply with the Partner Center offer ID and we'll open a validation ticket.

Best,
Michael Chen

Michael / team — quick technical notes for the validation run: 

- Smoke test (curl-based):
  1) POST https://api.us.redwood.ai/v1/generate with body {"prompt":"hello"} and header Authorization: Bearer test:read-only; expect 200 and a JSON with key 'reply'.
  2) GET https://api.us.redwood.ai/health -> 200 and {"status":"ok"}.

- Rate limits for test key: 5 rps burst, 10 concurrent connections. We recommend single-threaded smoke test.
- TLS: certificate is publicly verifiable (Let's Encrypt) and SNI is configured.
- CORS: Allowed origins include partner validation hosts.

If you need an ephemeral test key posted to Partner Center, we can create one and mark it for validation only.

Thanks,
